title.narrative: Second Private Sector and Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Development Program - Subprogram 2

description.narrative: Subprogram 2 of the Second Private Sector and Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Development Program (PSME2) and the TA loan support the government's strategy to develop and promote small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and undertake SME trade-related reforms to help achieve sustained and inclusive economic growth—a strategy embedded in the Seventh National Socio-Economic Development Plan (NSEDP7), 2011-2015.

description.narrative: By end of 2013 -- i) Number of newly registered enterprises reporting that operating licenses to start a business were obtained under 15 days, increased by 5% per year. (Baseline as of 2009: 55%) Progress/Status: At least 95% within 30 days and 78% within 10 days and 67% within 5 days. Data Source: GIZ Enterprise Survey Actual value:

ii) Percentage of women owned SMEs registered increased to 48% of total enterprises registered. (Baseline as of 2009: 43%) Progress/Status: Over 53% of individual enterprises registered are owned by women. Enterprises registered owned by woman is 79,002 (45.78%) Data Source: ERO completion report Actual value:
